sources.title: Marimonald/Ojisan-translator-v1-Qwen-3.5-9B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Ojisan-translator-v1-Qwen-3.5-9B is a specialized Japanese style-transfer language model fine-tuned on top of unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B. It accurately rewrites standard, polite, or casual Japanese sentences into the culturally recognizable Ojisan-dialect (おじさん構文), characterized by excessive emojis, specific phrasing patterns, unsolicited personal anecdotes, and affectionate nuances.
